ruleSets.notes: Model 1.0.3 (mapper changes; the disease model is 1.0.0): 187 diseases plus _other_, 426 features (surgical, medical, obstetric, paediatric, neurological, vascular), prior tiers (vademecum/priors.ts), unmodelled findings scored at the finding's background rate (engine/likelihood.ts; was a flat 0.30), bounded sex likelihood ratios and age/sex/pregnancy applicability (engine/modifiers.ts), feature mapper reads chips, vitals, history, results and free text (socrates-to-features.ts). Stops at posterior 0.85 or 8 questions.

changelog.change: Condition-neutral model (clinval C6): neutral background rates for unmodelled findings instead of 0.30; frequency-tier priors with no specialty boost (cholecystitis 0.15 → 0.015, GORD 0.12 → 0.03, PUD 0.10 → 0.015 …); sex modifiers bounded as likelihood ratios (inguinal hernia ×5/×0.3 → ×1.8/×0.2; gynaecological ×2.5 and breast ×1.8 boosts removed); applicability (sex, age, pregnancy); 58 new nodes (ACS, dissection, heart failure, AF, cardiac syncope, hypertensive emergency, pneumonia, asthma, COPD, sepsis, anaphylaxis, gastroenteritis, C. difficile, AKI, hyperkalaemia, hypercalcaemia, hyponatraemia, DKA, HHS, hypoglycaemia, phaeochromocytoma, stroke, TIA, SAH, meningitis, seizure, cauda equina, MSCC, pre-eclampsia/HELLP, abruption, hyperemesis, intussusception, pyloric stenosis, malrotation, HSP, mesenteric ischaemia, limb ischaemia, aorto-enteric fistula, femoral aneurysm, superficial thrombophlebitis, pyelonephritis, infected obstructed kidney, biliary colic, variceal bleed, perforated ulcer, food bolus, lower GI bleed, anal cancer, Fournier's, sigmoid volvulus, toxic megacolon, incarcerated hernia, post-operative collection and pneumonia, DFI, Charcot, inguinal nodes, anaplastic thyroid); feature mapper reads the whole consultation record. Versioned from unversioned.

Feature mapper precision (no disease, prior or likelihood changed). Every rule goes through record-text-match.ts: negated lists get a window per item ("never had pain, jaundice or fever"; "denies A, B and C"), family history is never the patient, symptoms and signs are not read from a sentence dated years back, a repaired or planned-for-repair condition or a lay guess, a [^.]{0,N} gap cannot cross a negation cue ("DRE: no mass"), requires-context must be affirmed. Pattern fixes: flame haemorrhages, restless + disorientated, rheumatoid arthritis, abscess drainage, defaecation as a syncope trigger, pale stools, calf pain on walking, pulse-oximetry, fistula cord, flatus incontinence and faecal urgency, rash on both legs, breast 'central' and 'diffuse neck' sites, RIF scar, distended neck veins, 'not passed urine' (oliguria), neuropathic pain; adrenal mass read from imaging. Clinval web: no expectation changed status. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/diagnostic-reasoning.md (precision pass).

Feature mapper reads the history frames (no disease, prior or likelihood changed): every frame answer key maps to an existing PANE feature (socrates-to-features.ts FRAME_KEY_RULES; e.g. sputum, haemoptysis, orthopnoea, MRC grade, lump consistency, cough impulse); pain-only features (episodic, nocturnal, post-prandial, colicky pain, worse on movement, severe, localised) come only from pain answers; 'Coughing' as an aggravating factor no longer sets the cough feature. Clinval web: 0 blocking, no expectation went pass -> fail. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/history-by-complaint.md.

Evidence-exam: new disease nodes cirrhosis (K74.60) and abdominal-wall pain / ACNES (G58.8, target of Carnett's sign); examination-sign and decision-rule band features registered from clinical-content/rules (lib/pane-engine/src/evidence: sensitivity and specificity from the likelihood ratios; finding-level signs marginalise over their finding); updatePosterior applies each evidence feature once and groups a decision rule with its components (engine/evidenceGroups.ts: the rule supersedes its component signs for its targets; its positive band adds only what the component findings have not already given); evidence features are never asked (Feature.askable false). Clinval web: no existing expectation changed status. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/evidence-exam.md.

Feature mapper only (no disease, prior or likelihood changed): the free-text cough rule counts a cough mention only when it records the symptom (lib/triage-engine/src/cough-mention.ts, shared vectors with iOS CoughMention): "pain worse on coughing", "aggravated by coughing" and "cough impulse" in the HPI no longer set the cough feature. docs/clinical-validation/changes/followups-history.md.

Precision pass against alert fatigue. Diagnosis families (diagnosis-families.ts, from PANE ids, labels and ICD-10): same ICD-10 category and head noun; injuries of one body region (S2x, S3x); complication or grade modifier (incarcerated, strangulated, perforated, gangrene, necrotising, infected, obstructed, toxic, major, minor, late, early) with a shared head noun in the same ICD-10 chapter or named in the parenthesis. Family members are compatible: never the leader of 'the record favours X', and a finding that favours one does not alert. Working node matched by label when it beats the ICD-10 match by 2 (words found minus missing; 1 word needs an ICD match, else 2; acute/chronic contradict). 'The record favours X' only when X shares evidence (LR >= 1.5 in both) with a working diagnosis that has support of its own (LR >= 2), and X is not already named in the working diagnosis. A single contradicting finding alerts at LR <= 0.2 (core 0.33). Time-out: findings explained by a coexisting state are explained. Alerts 77 -> 30 / 397, time-outs 103 -> 49 / 397.
